rules.sentence: Brucellosis is more prevalent in the young population, with 60% of cases in persons aged 13-40 years, 16% in those aged 40-60 years, and 2.5% in 60 years and older.[8]
Brucellosis may be more common in children in developing countries because of a lack of pasteurization.
Brucellosis is more common in males as compared to females.
Occupational exposure to animals is the most likely cause of this gender vulnerability.
